target_customer: Active traders and trading firms executing across crypto exchanges, prediction markets and tokenized-asset venues
problem: Liquidity is fragmented across venues and a best displayed quote may not fill large orders; traders lack one system to route and execute across them.
business_model: Execution platform via terminal, API, SDK and MCP; pricing not published

founders.name: Peter Bai
prior_employers: Trading team of a $13B fund (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: A secondary profile names the fund as University Pension Plan Ontario and the exchange operator as TMX Group, with a different fund size; not confirmed by the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Low-latency routing, venue connectivity across crypto, prediction and tokenized venues, and order graph logic with a five person team.

defensibility.rationale: Venue integrations and execution quality can lock in traders, but funded rivals such as River Markets and agg.market pursue the same wedge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Rivals raised seed rounds and venues were building tooling; no outcome for Sequence Markets yet.

market_need_then: Prediction market and perps volume is growing and liquidity is split across venues; the company reports 150+ signups in its first week (self-reported).

identity.visual_style: Minimal product page with graph-based order system tagline

brand_strength.rationale: Name is generic and confusable with Sequence (Polygon-acquired Web3 firm) and Sequence the fintech; no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Sequence Markets is an active YC Winter 2026 company building cross-venue execution for crypto, prediction and tokenized assets, led by a CEO with exchange and fund trading experience. Traction is only self-reported and funding beyond YC is not public. No exit or layoffs reported; competition from River Markets and others is the main risk.
notes: Funding unverified: CB Insights and PitchBook list a $500K convertible note or accelerator round dated 2026-01-01 from Y Combinator; PitchBook also lists other investors (Amino Capital, PAX Markets, angels); no primary source, so no round recorded. HQ conflicts (YC page Toronto, databases New York). Competition: River Markets and agg.market raised seeds but no date near the 2026 batch was found in the sources opened, list left empty.
